decisions.path: Cash Settlement Home Page/Functional Requirement/Deprecated docs/Cashflow Events Control Draft 1/page.md
decisions.reason: Hold this undated deprecated draft because it defines separate Amendment and Withdrawal & New events. The related Cashflow Events Control page says Stella and Murex 2.11 provide only Withdrawal and New events. Draft 2 repeats the additional event types but has no date or approval. The parent page also uses Drop1, Drop2, and Drop3 labels and leaves net-resultant handling open. Available sources do not identify the effective event contract or which version controls. Keep the retained draft pending owner clarification.
